## A Lasting Legacy

Over a career spanning more than five decades, Jarre scored over 150 films, earning nine Academy Award nominations and three wins. Born in Lyon, France, in 1924, he began his musical journey studying percussion before finding his true calling in composition, eventually becoming one of the most influential film composers of the 20th century.

Tributes poured in from across the film industry Sunday, with directors and musicians alike praising Jarre's ability to create themes that transcended their films—melodies that entered the popular consciousness and remained there for generations.

Jarre is survived by his children, including composer Jean-Michel Jarre, who has carried forward his own celebrated career in electronic music.

Funeral arrangements are pending.
